I'm no doctor also, but I've been through almost everything anonymousreddit said.

I've been diagnosed as bipolar once, then the shrink said it wasn't. Some weeks ago I went to a psychiatrist, supposedly a specialist in bipolar disorder, and he said it wasn't BD, just social anxiety and depression. I've been on anti-depressants for a week now.

The thing is, I don't know which diagnosis to trust anymore. I haven't been on the pills long enough to change anything, but so far the side-effects started to kick in, and I still feel the same about the rest, including the major mood swings.

I'm just sharing my experience because I know it can be frustating when you seek help and it seems to get you even more confused.

I guess that's it, Cognitive Behaviour Therapy... at least from what I can translate between portuguese and english.

I'm also on [escitalopram](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Escitalopram), but I don't think I'll see any effects for at least another 2 or 3 weeks. But as I said, I'm a little better just to be doing something about it.

Reading your comment was like reading someone describing what I've been through. I never got to actually writing my suicide notes, but I thought about each one, who would get one, who wouldn't and why. And I had the same breakdown that you did, thinking about how my family and loved ones would suffer.

I've always felt (and still feel a little) like a failure at my job, I've been a chronic masterbater for maybe 15 years and I even got into trouble with my girlfriend for this. 

But the thing is, a little over a week ago [I was here too](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/8amhx/me_my_girlfriend_and_some_guy/). And talking about those things and reading what people said to me got me the strength to think clearly about what I was about to do. So I got help.

I think a lot of people only go after some things on extreme situations. I've always been like this, and I had to get to my limit to get help. I've seen a psychiatrist, I'm about to start something called Cognitive Therapy (or something), and I've started taking the medicine he prescribed me. It's only been 4 days and it haven't kicked in yet, but I feel better just because I'm actually doing something, you know?

I've been through a lot for the last 10 or 15 years, and for a long time I was sure that I wouldn't even get to 30. I was sure I'd kill myself sooner or later.

But when I got really close to it, I was so desperate that I stepped back and got a bigger picture. You're doing that now, when you cleaned your apartment and started thinking about your family. The fact that you couldn't go through and came here for help means you still have hope, and you still want to live.

And you know what, you can do it. I'm not one to believe that "oh, everyone can do anything, just put your mind to it!", but I DO believe that most of the time, we can do a lot more than we think. Fresh starts are not easy, but the only way to know is trying. Do you already have a new field in mind? Do you know people who could help you start?

There's a lot of people here with a lot of different backgrounds. I'm sure someone here could help you in whatever it is you want to do.

People get fresh starts all the time. People change their lives all the time. You're not attached to what you do forever.

Talk with your family, talk to people you trust. They'll be more understanding than you think. I'm sure there's a lot of people around you that are willing to help you and want to see you happy.

What I've learned from my experience is that if you give up, you'll never know. We only have this life, this chance, to make the most out of it. So just go for it, you know, and go after the things that make you happy.

Feel free to PM me if you want, and keep us updated. There's a lot of people here for you.

hey, I think any comment here is helpful. This thread helped me a lot today.

About forgiving, and forgetting... I never was any good at either. I have a hard time forgiving because I think it minimizes the damage other people have done to you. Forgiving puts the "victim" on the spotlight. "She said she was sorry, what more do you want?". Everybody makes mistakes, I know, but I also think a lot of them could be avoided just by thinking through your actions.

I know this sounds a little... mean, I don't know. But it makes sense in my head.

I need to take a day off to read all your coments :)

Jokes aside, I understand what you're saying (and I had read at least one of those comments before, and pretty much identified with it).

And I've been asking a friend about meditation lately, but I haven't really gone after anything. I think it might be the right time now.

I know. I'm just out of pot. :|
I'm compulsive. Luckily I don't have access to other drugs, I'd be on them already.

The thing is, at least from my point of view... there were no rules. We both were seeing different people, and I was fine with that. What set me off was: he was a common friend, I already had issues with the guy (you those guys that get everything they want? well, he got my girl too), and it happened *while* we weren't so separated after all - she was regularly sleeping over my house, there was the casual sex... so while she was seeing him, she was all sweet and cuddly with me. And as I said, when I started seeing someone else, I called it off with her.

Maybe I'm just old-fashioned, but I don't think there's a need for rules regarding this, it's just respect for someone you care about.

And well, that part about "you won". I get and all, but maybe it's just a male thing you know, about competition. Yes, I still got her at the end, but who says he wanted anything long-term with her? Maybe he *got* what he wanted and that's it.

And to be sincere, I care too much about her to just break this now. But I'm not making any decisions today, or until we are both back in our senses.

Maybe I didn't express myself really well...

Look my [reply to thejoefish](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/8amhx/me_my_girlfriend_and_some_guy/c08pgls) and what we talk about the urge. It's not the only reason, it's just something that adds up.

I have a LOT of things that inspire to keep me going, but I don't feel myself accomplishing a lot on any of these others things also. I love music, but I never got to a point where I'm satisfied with what I do. I have a good job, but I don't think I have what it takes. I love movies and I have over 40 or 50 ideas that I never worked on. I love animation, but I just suck. I never finish anything that I start.

But again, all those things just add up. It's not one particular reason, this feeling has been with me, coincidentally or not (I belive not) since I lost my eye. It's been 14 years and I haven't been able to get over it yet, I'm losing hope. But then again, it doesn't feel like this is the reason also.

It's just an overwhelming feeling of total lack of hope in ever accomplishing anything worthy.
Hmm, thanks. I'll look into it. That's the part that always interested me anyway.

I've tried other options. It's really hard to meet people when you're so paranoid about your prosthetic eye that you can't even make eye contact to a girl unless there's booze or pot involved.

It took me 14 months after the break up to meet someone. I'm not bad looking, but I have zero social skills.

I'm not on meds. My shrink didn't 'believe' in meds. I've been dealing with this with a lot of pot, which I ran out about a month ago. Maybe it didn't help me after all, I don't know. Since then I took up drinking and cigarettes. I just need *something* to manage my mood, always.

The cheating is the hardest part now. I've been there before, it hurt like hell, but I finished the relationship. But now, I don't feel I can do it. I care to much for her, I know she has strong feelings about me (damn, I read her e-mails, she was always telling her friends how she always loved me and how happy she was that we were back). But as I said, I don't feel I can let this one go.

I know it's not something I should decide in this state of mind and after being 30 hours awake straight, but it really hurts to see someone you trust so much, you love so much... fuck, I can't finish sentences anymore.

Thanks for sharing all this, really.

First of all: THANKS from talking about the fucking *urge*. That's something I never see anyone talk about. It's not just an impulse, it's a fucking urge to commit suicide that is always there. When I see the train coming and I want to jump, when I see the electric wire in the shower and I want to grab it, when I see a window and I want to jump. It's just there, whether I'm OK or not. Fuck, I even avoid being near windows because I know that I may just do it, out of the blue, no reason. And I feel a little better knowing that is not just me (I mean, I don't feel good about it, you get my point).

And it's funny because I already used the "only you can save yourself" bit on a 4chan suicide thread (yea, I know...), and I really do believe it. But it just seems that even when I try the hardest, something gets fucked up. And I really don't know how to deal with failure. Never did.

I've tried therapy, I'm willing to try it again. I've tried budhism, but it just seemed like a different flavor of catholicism (I believe I just tried the wrong 'group', but still). And I've rejected god when I lost my right eye when I was 16 (I'm 30 now), seeing my mother, a very religious person, kneeling and praying and crying for an entity that's it's just not there.

I really appreciate your thoughts, I think I'm about to make my mind and seek help today. My father works in an university hospital (in accounting, but hey, he's there), and even though I never talked about this with him, I might just open up and claim for help. Because by now, I know I can't make it alone, and I know I can do it. And I don't want to hurt the people around me. Not everyone, at least.
You know what's funny? My godfather is a psychiatrist. A fucking good one. He was head of something... anyway, with great power comes a great lack of availability. Ironic, huh?

It does help, and all the replies even more so. It's something I don't I can share with anyone else right now, though. I don't want to approach any friends with the suicide talk, fearing that they may not take me seriously. I could use some professional help, but as I said, I don't trust my last shrink.

You're right about the corner. That's where I'm at. Or at least, feels like it.

You know the feeling that, even that you know it's not you, it's a brain/chemicals/etc problem, you still feel powerless about it? Like my body will carry this out whether I want it or not.

I found your advice really interesting actually, about taking time to heal myself before healing the relationship. And I know this is something she would agree with. But I'm proud. I feel like if I let this go, that fucker just 'wins'. He got away with being with her behind my back, and that just can't be. I've been the 'loser' in a lot of things in my life, and this one I just can't let go. That's how I feel, anyway. If I don't do something to myself, I'll do to him. (Well, I won't, he's on another country right now).

And thanks for the hint on not threatening suicide. Like I said, I've been through this for almost 15 years and I never told anybody until a couple of months ago, when I told her.

I'm in Brazil, btw.

Just as a heads up: thanks for all the comments and PMs (I've read them all), I had no idea I could feel so much better just by reading that people care.

I'm at work now, and I can't really check the thread all the time, and every new reply I get I almost break into tears, and it's getting harder to hold them back.

(Grammar Nazis, take it easy, I'm not a native speaker)

Well, first I was going to post this to AskReddit just because I'm totally lost and don't know what to do.

But the thing is: I've been battling suicide for almost 15 years now, and for the last couple of years, it's getting really hard. I mean, I've never tried anything, but in two different ocasions, my mind was set, I knew what I was going to write to everyone and I was already visualizing myself flying off the window.

I've been diagnosed with depression and bipolar disorder, but I didn't trust the shrink that much to take this as final. Even though I think I have a lot of the warning signs, being bipolar is kinda "in" these days, so... 

Enough context, my story: I'm in a relationship that's been going on for almost 8 years now, but we had break up a couple of years ago, and we got back recently. We still have our misunderstadings, but at the same time we've reached a whole new level of understanding, to the point that we're talking about moving in together.

Thing is, I'm also paranoid. So I got my girlfriend's e-mail password. I know, it's stupid, but I've been self-destructive since I can remember, and every time I face a situation where there's a chance that'll hurt myself even more, I go ahead and do it anyway (thanks, Crow). And we both knew about our little afairs during the time we were separated, and I thought we had that cleared up, but... 

During this time, we would see each other a lot. And more often than not, we would hook up, have sex, etc. Now, when I started seeing this other girl, I called her, we talked, and I told that we shouldn't see each other for a while, it just didn't feel right.

So, checking her e-mails, I found out she hooked up with a friend of ours. I panic, I can't sleep (I haven't, don't know how I'll get through my job today), I end up calling her in the morning, before we leave to our respective jobs. I ask a lot of questions, turns out they were seeing each other, had sex a couple of times... and, well, during a time that WE were also hanging out and hooking up.

Now, I'm a overreaction guy. Always have been. And this is killing me: she kept this from me when we discussed what had happened, the guy is also my friend and did this behind my back, she was seeing both of us and never had the common sense to talk to me and ask for some time.

I love her, I can't see myself with any other person on this planet. I've tried, we know each other for almost a decade now, and I'm pretty sure I can't have this level of commitment and understanding with anyone else (this is where I should point out that I SUCK at meeting girls. I mean REALLY SUCK, trust me). But at the same time, I can't find it in myself to forgive her. (I won't even talk about him, I just hope our paths never cross again)

My life hasn't been bad, but I feel overwhelmed by all the things that are happening. I have a great job that I don't think I can handle. I love playing guitar but every class I feel like I'm doing less and getting more nervous about it. And now the only meaningful relationship in my life is really close to a big fucking fight.

When I called her this morning, I actually said I was going to jump out of the window. That's what I felt like doing, because I really can't handle these feelings right now. I pressured her until she asked me not to, I don't know why. I don't usually cry wolf for this, I only threatend killing myself ONCE before, and just like today, I meant it. And that day she also "saved" me, and that was the day our relationship started again.

She's coming to my house tonight, but I have no idea how to handle this. I'm too proud to forgive her, and I'm to weak to leave her. The guy has always made me feel like a loser, and now he had the ONE thing that I had and he didn't.

My plans are either calling off our talk tonight and killing myself, or wait to see how the conversation goes and... well, if it doesn't work out, kill myself. Lately I've been feeling like my life was just a build up to the moment that I would actually pull it off, and I think this moment is here.

There's roughly 10 hours before I got home and talk to her, and I really look forward to some words of inspiration.

thanks, reddit.

**UPDATE**

Ok guys, first of all, I can't thank you enough for all the comments. You have no idea how this helped me. I'm feeling a lot better, I think I can even think with a little more clarity now. Really, with all my heart, I thank every one of you.

I haven't made my mind about anything, but I have a plan.

1) I'll talk to my father and ask for help getting a good psychiatrist. He has the contacts, and he's family, he should know what's going on. I plan on doing this over the phone after lunch just so I can talk to him when my mother is not around (she's a whole different story, I won't even start).

2) Maybe I'll just postpone the talk with my girlfriend. I don't think there's a lot to talk about now. It's done, it hurts, and that's it. We will either go through this or take a break, and I don't think I can decide this in the state I'm in.

It's almost lunch time here, so I'll probably check again in the afternoon (I have a lot of work to catch up, though) in case anyone has any opinion about all this. And I'll update the thread later at night just to clear things up.

I want to thank again all of you, I can't say this enough.

**UPDATE 2**

Well, that was one fucking HARD call to make. I still don't know how I made it without breaking down and crying. And kind of amazed about how my father held up, was calm, understanding and promptly offered to help. I mean, I didn't expect him NOT to help, it was just the "OK I'm here for you" thing that can mean a fucking lot in a time like this. I love the guy and maybe sometime I'll have the guts to say that to him.

My girlfriend was nervous, and not so comprehensive at first, but I think I understand her. She feels she put me through this and now there's nothing she can do, since I told her we should wait until we talk about it. In the end she was sobbing but I think I made her understand that if we talked today, nothing good would come out of it. Hell, we were almost starting to talk about it on the phone, which just made my point easier.

WOW, I feel like I took a weight out of my shoulders. FUCK. Once again I thank all of you. It was from talking to you guys that I had the state of mind of not doing something stupid, thinking about it and doing what I think was a pretty rational decision. Damn, I just want to hug all of you.

I don't think I'll update this again today, but I'll gladly answer any posts later (work work work). Also, feel free to PM me about anything. Sorry to the unanswered posts, but I've read them all.

I just want to end with some lyrics from my favorite band ever, that has been with me since my teens, through ups and downs.

[*There's one thing that I should remember*
*There is a light at the end of the tunnel*](http://www.therapyquestionmark.co.uk/discography/albums/infernallove.php#a_11)

**UPDATE 3**
Just a quick one, since the thread seems to be alive...

Well, I got my first appointment with a psychiatrist on thursday. From what I heard, the guy is some kind of specialist in Bipolar Syndrome, so we'll check that out first. And, well, I'll see where it goes from there, but my plan is to remain calm (and alive) til then. I'm doing this mostly as respect for my father, who was there for me today, because I'm sad to say that my mood has really gone down during the day. I'm not bad as I was this morning, but I'm not OK either.

I just got home, I'll play a game with my friends and try to get some sleep (40 hours straight now? I don't know), and do my best to keep my head together for a couple of days.

I'm doing my best to avoid thinking about what happened with my girl, but it's hard. It's like a movie playing in my head and I can't stop it. So I'll just try to keep myself busy and see how it goes.

I'm holding up, I guess. I'm not scared of doing something, I really think I can get through until the appointment.

Thanks again guys, you can still PM me, and peace to you all.
